info.summary: B2B lead intelligence and outbound sales API
info.description: REST API for OutReign saved leads, deals, activities, contacts and AI email generation. Authenticate with X-API-Key from Settings → API Keys. MCP OAuth and webhook contracts are documented separately at https://docs.outreign.io.
